localChanges: chore: work towards a 3D map, not offered yet: under ?3d=1 with the realistic sets, Paratroopers sway under their canopies, fire from the hip and go limp in the harness with their own clips (#1400)

log: The Paratroopers stand under their parachute with a hand on the SMG slung at the hip and the other on a riser. Their canopy sways and swings above them as they wait and move; they turn to fire a three-round burst from the hip, looking where they fire; and when they die they go limp in the harness as the canopy tips over.
A rig can put a muzzle on a bone, for a weapon that's part of the figure rather than a prop of its own, and its shots leave from there.
